summary.business_type: Local service / B2B agency (performance marketing for real-estate developers, Coimbatore TN)
summary.scope_note: Audited the local production build of commit c18988e. The public host was unreachable from the audit container, so live headers, TLS, CDN, CrUX/GSC field data and real-world CWV are NOT covered.
top_findings: Zero outbound citations on a site whose argument is verifiability
21 of 31 titles exceed 60 characters and will truncate in SERPs
Homepage H1 extracts as run-together text: 'watch wherethe moneyactually goes.'
llms.txt fails the llmstxt.org/Lighthouse rule: no Markdown links
quick_wins: Rewrite llms.txt entries as Markdown links
Add spaces between the H1 span lines
Shorten the 8 article titles that run 70-85 chars

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt reachable, 18 groups, 11 named AI user agents

findings.title: Live-server surface not audited
findings.description: Egress policy blocked the public host, so HTTPS/HSTS, compression, cache headers and CDN behaviour were not checked.
findings.recommendation: Re-run against https://growdigitalbranding.com once network access is widened.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: filler_score 0 and ai_pattern_score 0 on every page sampled

findings.title: Zero outbound citations site-wide
findings.description: Across all 7 articles and 24 other pages there is not one external link. The site repeatedly claims its numbers are 'a matter of public record' but never links the record (RERA portals, Meta/Google documentation, DTCP).
findings.recommendation: Add 2-4 primary-source links per article to the documents each claim rests on.

findings.title: Five pages under 300 words
findings.recommendation: tracking-setup is the one that matters commercially - it is a proof page with 6 H2s and 154 words. The calculators are interactive tools and are acceptable thin.

findings.title: Articles are weakly linked internally
findings.description: Contextual inbound links per article: 3-12, against 29-30 for every other page (which is the global footer). get-cited-by-ai-assistants and rera-approval-status-lead-quality have 3 each.
findings.recommendation: Cross-link articles from the service pages whose subject they support.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 on all 31 pages
Title and meta description present on all 31

findings.title: 21 of 31 titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: The brand suffix '| growdigitalbranding' is 20 chars and pushes 8 article titles to 70-85. 'Channel partner leads vs direct leads: the real cost comparison | growdigitalbranding' is 85.
findings.recommendation: Drop the brand suffix on article pages, or shorten the article titles to ~40 chars.

findings.title: Homepage H1 extracts as run-together text
findings.description: The H1 is three display:block spans with no whitespace between them, so naive text extractors read 'watch wherethe moneyactually goes.' Browsers and Google render it correctly; plain-text extractors, which many AI crawlers use, do not.
findings.recommendation: Add a space or newline between the span elements.

findings.title: Four pages have no H2 at all
findings.recommendation: The two who-we-help pages are ~280 words of unstructured prose; give each 2-3 question-shaped H2s.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: @graph with stable @id on all 31 pages; no duplicate or conflicting entity declarations
BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage on all 7 articles

findings.title: No Offer or PriceSpecification on /pricing
findings.description: The page publishes three real prices in prose and markup but declares no Offer, so it cannot win a price-related rich result or be quoted as structured pricing.
findings.recommendation: Add Offer/PriceSpecification nodes for the three tiers, referencing the existing Service @ids.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList on depth-1 pages
findings.description: Present on all depth-2 pages; absent on /work, /pricing, /the-loop, /insights, /tools, /what-we-do, /who-we-help, /about.
findings.recommendation: Add a two-level trail (Home > Page) to the eight depth-1 routes.

findings.title: No Google Business Profile in sameAs
findings.description: For a Coimbatore agency this is the single highest-value entity link and it is absent.
findings.recommendation: Claim the listing and add its URL.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0.0007 on the homepage and 0.0000 on the other three pages measured
All 57 images carry explicit width and height

findings.title: Homepage transfers 2.2MB over 49 requests
findings.description: Lab measurement on localhost: homepage 2195KB / 49 requests / LCP 1756ms, against 401-501KB / 30-33 requests / LCP 128-148ms for interior pages. The delta is the 19 creative WebPs (1.7MB on disk) in the marquee. LCP in absolute terms is meaningless on loopback, but the payload is real and on an Indian 4G connection it is the difference between a good and a poor LCP.
findings.recommendation: Serve the marquee creatives responsively, and consider loading a subset above the fold.

findings.title: next/image is not used anywhere
findings.description: Zero imports across the codebase. Every image is a raw at a single 640x857 intrinsic size, so a 390px phone downloads the same asset a desktop does - no srcset, no AVIF negotiation, no automatic sizing.
findings.recommendation: Move the marquee to next/image, or hand-write srcset/sizes with AVIF sources.

findings.title: Field data unavailable
findings.description: No CrUX or GSC access from this container, and the origin may have no CrUX sample yet at current traffic.
findings.recommendation: Connect Search Console and re-check once traffic accrues.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All three P0 agent-readiness checks pass

robots.txt names 11 AI user agents deliberately (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) with no search crawler blocked at root
Unknown URLs return a real 404 rather than a soft 200
Direct-answer blocks and question-shaped H2s on most pages

findings.title: llms.txt fails the llmstxt.org rule Lighthouse checks
findings.description: The file is 2737 bytes and well written, but every entry is a bare path ('- /the-loop - the methodology') rather than a Markdown link. The spec requires Markdown links; Lighthouse scores it as fail.

findings.title: No /llms-full.txt
findings.recommendation: Optional; consider once the article set is stable.

findings.title: Lead form is not annotated for WebMCP
findings.description: One form on the homepage, zero annotated. Forward-looking, not a current ranking factor.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 57 of 57 images have alt text - no missing alt anywhere on the site
All carry width and height, which is why CLS is ~0
Intrinsic 640x857 against a 260x325 slot is a sane ~2x DPR

findings.title: 30 of 31 pages contain zero images
findings.description: The homepage holds all 57 image instances (19 unique client ad creatives). /work, /about, /pricing, /the-loop and all 7 articles have none. No image can rank in Google Images, no article has a lead visual for social or Discover, and the pages that carry the trust argument show nothing.
findings.recommendation: This is a production task, not a code one: a portrait for /about, artefact photography for /work, and one diagram or chart per article.

findings.title: No per-page OG images
findings.description: Every page shares the single /og.png. Seven articles with distinct titles all render an identical social card.
findings.recommendation: Generate per-article OG images from the article title.

phases.name: Phase 1: Quick wins
items: Rewrite llms.txt entries as Markdown links
Add whitespace between the homepage H1 span lines
Shorten the 8 article titles running 70-85 chars, or drop the brand suffix on articles

phases.name: Phase 2: High-impact
items: Add 2-4 primary-source outbound citations per article
Claim the Google Business Profile and add it to sameAs
Move the marquee creatives to responsive images and cut the 2.2MB homepage payload

phases.name: Phase 3: Content and authority
items: Photography: portrait for /about, artefacts for /work, one visual per article
Cross-link articles from the service pages whose subject they support

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring
items: Connect Search Console and GA4; re-run this audit against the live host
Capture a seo-drift baseline so future deploys are diffed
Re-check CrUX once the origin has a field-data sample
